description: Build an unsigned transaction to deposit assets into an Arcadia account as collateral. Supports ERC20 tokens and ERC721 NFTs (LP positions). NOT needed before write.account.add_liquidity — that tool deposits from wallet atomically. Ensure the account is approved first (call read.wallet.allowances to check, then write.wallet.approve if needed). Account version is auto-detected on-chain (override with account_version if needed).

account_version.description: Override account version (3 or 4). Auto-detected on-chain if omitted.

asset_amounts.description: Amounts in raw units/wei, one per asset

asset_ids.description: Token IDs: 0 for ERC20, NFT token ID for ERC721

asset_types.description: V4 only. Asset types per asset: 1=ERC20, 2=ERC721, 3=ERC1155. If omitted, inferred from asset_ids (non-zero → ERC721).

name: write.account.deposit
